note: What the three of them say when somebody clicks on them. Lifted out of the pane so the page stops paying for them and so the pool can grow without a ceiling. Regenerate and replace this file alone to change what they say; the window does not need rebuilding for it. Keyed by man, then by window, plus `any` for lines that fit any hour. The `game` block is hide and seek, read by the pane only when the game is built into it; it is written here whether or not it is, so that turning the game on is a one-file change to the pane and not a two-file one.

any: There's always food. That isn't luck, it's a policy.
If you're standing there deciding whether to knock, knock.
Bread's proving. Most of the job is waiting and then taking the credit.
I'd offer you something, but you're on the other side of a window.
Somebody left the flour out. It was me. I'm dealing with it.
The kitchen isn't a domain. It's just where the knives live.
morning: Coffee's on. I made too much again, which is the correct amount.
Six in the morning is the only time this kitchen is quiet. I get about forty minutes.
The dough's been up longer than I have. Show off.
Awake since five and I have already lost a spatula.
Moose has decided the morning starts when he says it does. He's usually right.
afternoon: Second lunch is a real meal. I've done the research.
Something's in the oven and I'm pretending to be relaxed about it.
This is the hour where I open the fridge, look in, and close it. Twice.
Afternoons are for the slow things. Stock, bread, and arguments about height.
I'm told the leftovers were for everyone. I'm reviewing that policy.
night: Kitchen's closed. The kitchen is never closed. Ask me anyway.
There's soup. There is always soup at this hour.
Everyone's fed, the counter's clean, and I'm going to sit down for one minute.
This is my favorite hour. Nobody needs anything and I can hear the fridge.
If you're up this late, eat something. That's not advice, that's the rule here.
spring: The window is open for the first time this year. I keep putting a jumper on anyway.
Everything smells green. I have started putting herbs in things that do not need herbs.
Petals all over the sill. I am not sweeping them up yet.
summer: Too hot to have the oven on, so obviously I have had the oven on.
The light goes on forever this time of year. Dinner keeps happening at ten.
There are things on the roof that want watering and I am pretending not to notice the time.
autumn: Soup weather. I have been waiting for soup weather since about March.
The leaves get in whenever anybody opens the door. I have stopped minding.
First proper cold day, and the oven has been on since noon for no particular reason.
winter: It is warm in here and it is not warm out there, and that is most of what a kitchen is for.
Snow. I have been out in it once already and I will go again.
Everything takes twice as long to rise in this cold. Worth it.
monday: Monday. I have already made too much of something, which is how I handle it.
Everyone is slower today and I think that is correct.
New week. I have a list and I have already ignored the order of it.
friday: It is Friday and I am making something that takes too long on purpose.
Friday. Nobody has anywhere to be at seven, which is my favourite fact about it.
I do the shopping on a Friday so the weekend is just cooking.
weekend: Nobody has to be anywhere. I still got up at six, which I am told is a problem.
Weekend. There is bread going and no reason for it.
Best two days for a long thing in the oven. Nothing to rush it for.
newyear: New year. The kitchen is exactly the same and I find that reassuring.
Everyone is making declarations. I have made soup.
First of January. Somebody has to feed all these resolutions.
yearend: Nobody knows what day it is this week and it has not hurt anybody yet.
The odd week. Nothing is due, so I am cooking for far more people than are here.
Last few days of the year and the fridge is a museum. I am working through it.
midwinter: Shortest day. The oven has been on since noon and I am not apologising.
Dark by four, which just means dinner starts earlier.
It turns from here. That is worth something warm.
midsummer: Longest day of the year and I have used approximately all of it.
It is barely dark. I keep forgetting to eat and then eating at ten.
Midsummer. Everything is happening outside and I am in here, happily.

any: You are looking at a picture of a room. I am aware of the irony.
Everything here is where I put it. That is the entire decor.
People assume the glasses are prescription. I let them.
I do not tidy. I place a thing once.
The shelves are ordered. Not alphabetically. Better than alphabetically.
I am told a window ought to be inviting. I have decided that is optional.
morning: I have been awake for some time. That is not an accusation.
The morning is the only part of the day nobody has interfered with yet.
Somebody has moved the kettle. I will work out who, and I will say nothing.
I do not require conversation before eight. I am told this is noticeable.
The light is correct at this hour. The rest of the day is a compromise.
afternoon: Yes, I am reading. No, it is not urgent. That is rather the point of it.
The afternoon is when people schedule things. I have views about people.
I am working. The stillness is the work. This is not obvious from outside.
Someone downstairs is being cheerful at volume. I am choosing to allow it.
I have been in this chair two hours and moved once, deliberately.
night: The house is quiet and everything is where I left it. A good night.
I keep late hours. It is preference, not insomnia, and I will not be examined on it.
There is tea going cold beside me. There is always tea going cold beside me.
At this hour the only sound is the building. I find that acceptable.
I am told the correct thing to do now is sleep. I have noted the advice.
spring: The light has moved forty minutes earlier in a fortnight. I noticed on the third day.
Everything out there is putting out growth it cannot yet support. It is a strategy.
Petals get into the hinges, and nobody thinks about it until the door sticks.
summer: The long evenings are useful. Nothing closes when it says it will.
Fireflies, if you are up late enough. They are not signalling to you.
Heat makes people careless about what they say. I find the season informative.
autumn: Everything is dropping what it cannot carry through the cold. I will not spell out the rest.
The leaves go to the same corner of the yard every year. The wind is not improvising.
Better light for reading, and less of it. An awkward trade.
winter: Sound carries differently in cold air. You can hear the quay from here tonight.
Snow records everything that walks through it. I approve of the principle.
Short days. The work does not get shorter.
monday: A week is a system and this is the morning it tells you whether it was ever running. Most weeks it was not.
Monday gets blamed for arriving. It is the only day that shows up on time and the only one anybody resents for it.
I have no complaint about Mondays. They are the first opportunity in seven days to be precise about something, and most people spend them recovering.
friday: Friday evening is better than anything the weekend will actually do with itself. I have never once been wrong about that and I have stopped arguing it.
The work is finished or it is not. Either way the light goes orange at the same hour and I have learned to stop negotiating with it.
A threshold is the only part of a house worth standing in, which is what Friday is for.
weekend: Two days with nothing scheduled behind them. I intend to spend them taking one thing apart until I own it.
The building runs quieter at the weekend and you can hear the place itself. Old radiators have opinions.
I am told the point of a weekend is to do nothing. I tried it, got very good at it, and stopped, which rather proves the difficulty.
newyear: The first of January is a number changing. Whatever you were doing on the thirty first is still what you are doing.
Resolutions are a forecast dressed as a decision. I would rather see what somebody does in February.
I keep no resolutions and I keep excellent records. One of those two is still useful in March.
yearend: These four days belong to no month and no week. Nothing is open and nothing is owed, and I find it harder than work.
The town is running on a skeleton and every system in it is showing you what it looks like with the load off. Worth watching.
I have been told to rest. I am reading the year back instead, which is the same activity performed correctly.
midwinter: The longest night, and then it turns. I have always preferred the turning to the spring it eventually produces.
Dark at four in the afternoon. The whole place runs on lamplight and every face in it is better for the change.
midsummer: Light until ten at night. Nothing is withheld, and I find I miss the withholding.
The longest day, which means from tomorrow it goes the other way. I am usually the only person pleased about that.
Everything is visible for eighteen hours. An excellent season for reading a room and a poor one for standing in one unread.

any: A bed should outlast the building it is in. That is the whole of my opinion on furniture.
Water first, then hands. It is a good order for a day.
The garden is slower than anyone wants. That is not a fault in the garden.
I do not rate a loaf on the day it is baked. Come back on the fifth.
There is a piece of wood in my room that holds nothing up. I kept it anyway.
You are welcome to stand there a while. Nothing here is in a hurry.
morning: The day is long and it has only just started. There is no need to run at it.
I am up before the light most days. The light does not seem to mind.
I have made tea. It will be too hot for eleven minutes. I have waited longer for less.
Something in the garden grew overnight. It does that whether I watch or not.
Mornings are honest. Nothing has gone wrong yet and nobody is pretending it has.
afternoon: This is the hour the day leans on. Everything after it is easier.
I am doing one thing slowly. It will be finished when it is finished.
The wood was cut before I was born. I am only the second person to have a view about it.
Somebody upstairs is arguing about an inch. It has been going on for a year.
Sunday's bread is better today. I said it would be. Nobody has come back to confirm it.
night: The house settles at night. So does everyone in it, eventually.
I do not need much sleep. I have never worked out whether that is a gift.
It is late and the kitchen light is on. It usually is.
This is a good hour for a long thought. There is nowhere for it to be interrupted.
Everything here will outlast the week. That is a comfortable thing to sit with.
spring: Ground is soft again. Good time to put something in it.
It comes back every year. That is the whole trick of it.
Everything young out there. It does not know yet how hard it gets.
summer: Warm enough to sit out. I do.
The heat will break. It always does.
autumn: Good season. It asks you to finish what you started.
The cold is coming, and it is not a threat. It is a date.
winter: Nothing to do out there now but wait, and waiting is a job.
Snow. It will be gone, and it will be back.
monday: The week is long. There is no need to meet all of it this morning.
Monday is a name somebody gave it. The work is the same work.
friday: The week ending is not an instruction.
Finish what will not keep. The rest waits.
Good day to put things down where you will find them again.
weekend: Two days is enough to build something small all the way through.
The quiet is the point. Do not fill all of it.
newyear: A day with a new number on it. Start anyway.
People decide things this week. Some of them hold.
I do not make resolutions. I keep the ones I made years ago.
yearend: Nothing is due. That is rarer than it sounds.
The year is finished and nobody has told the work yet.
Good week for reading back rather than forward.
midwinter: Shortest day. It comes back from here.
Cold and dark, and both of them honest.
This is the bottom of it. Worth marking.
midsummer: The longest day, and from tomorrow it shortens. Both are fine.
Use it. It does not keep.

julian: Right. I am somewhere. For the record, I did try.
Hidden. I will say now that this was the only room I fit in.
Go on. I am going to be very still and it is not going to help.
vex: I am concealed. You will not find me quickly.
Hidden, on sightlines rather than sentiment.
Begin. I would like to watch your method.
alaric: I am hidden. Take your time.
Go on. I am not going anywhere.

julian: Warmer. Sorry. I cannot help myself.
Warm. That was me helping, which is cheating, and I am at peace with it.
Close. Very close. I am saying nothing else.
vex: Closer. I will not say by how much.
You are warm, and that was not a guess. We both know it.
Warmer. Do it again and think about why it worked.

julian: Colder. Lovely room though.
Not there. Never been in there in my life.
Cold. Keep going, you are doing well.
vex: No.
Cold. You are searching where you would hide, which is a different problem.
Not there. That room has one door and I do not use rooms with one door.

julian: How. I was so still.
Found. I have a great many limbs and they all had to go somewhere.
Fair. Six foot five and a curtain was never going to work.
Right, yes. I was going to come out anyway. Eventually. Probably.
Well spotted. I was holding my breath and I want you to know it did nothing.
You got me. I knocked something over a minute ago and chose not to mention it.
Ah. I did wonder whether the shoes were visible.
Found. In my defence, this was the only room with a door I fit through.
There you are. I was starting to talk to myself in here.
Yes. Alright. I am not built for this and we both knew that going in.
vex: You were guessing. I would like that noted.
Found. Your third choice did the work, not your first.
Acceptable. Ask me again in an hour and it will be harder.
Correct. I will not tell you which part of that was skill.
Yes. You went to the room with two exits, which is the right instinct applied badly.
Found. I assumed you would start where you started. You did not. Noted.
Well. A better result than the method deserved.
You have me. I would like to watch you repeat it.
Correct, and slower than you think. I counted.
Found. I chose this room for the sightline, and nobody was looking down it.
alaric: You looked properly. That is the whole of it.
Found. Seven feet was always going to be a problem.
Good. You did not rush it.
Yes. I heard you two rooms ago.
Found. I was not going to move.
You had it narrowed before you opened the door.

julian: That was immediate. That was genuinely insulting.
One look? I had a whole plan.
Straight here. Lovely. I will be reconsidering everything.
vex: That fast. Either you know something or you were lucky, and I dislike both.
Two looks. I will be revising my assumptions.
Immediately. I would very much like to know why.

julian: Finally. My leg went to sleep about four rooms ago.
There you are. I have had time to think about a great many things.
Took you a while. I am not complaining, I am noting it, warmly.
vex: At last. I had begun composing a list of the things you were doing wrong.
You took your time. I have been standing still and thinking about doors.
Found, eventually. I want the number recorded.
alaric: You kept going. That is the part worth having.
A long look. It did not put you off.
There. You did not give up.

julian: It is my room. I was always going to end up in my room.
Yes, I hid in my own bedroom. I have had a lot on today.
vex: My own room. I am aware of how that reads.
Here. The room I know best, which is either the worst hiding place or the only one.
alaric: My room. It has the fewest corners.
Here. I did not think you would try it first.

nobody: The Room is empty just now, so there is nobody in the flat to go and hide.
Nobody is home to hide. Come back when somebody is in.

julian>vex: I made too much again.
You say that as though it were an accident.
Come and eat something.
I will. I am not going to say when.
You have been standing there a while.
I have been reading. Those are different.
vex>julian: You left the flour out.
I know. I am building up to it.
That is the third thing you have offered me today.
And you have taken none of them, so I am not out of ideas yet.
Somebody has moved my glasses.
They are on your head.
julian>alaric: There is a chair right there.
There is. I am not tired yet.
You have been up on that roof since noon.
It is done now. It will hold.
Anything from the kitchen?
Later. Ask me again.
alaric>julian: You have been on your feet since five.
That is the job. Also I like it.
Leave the rest. It keeps.
It does not, actually. That is the entire problem with bread.
Sit down for ten minutes.
In a minute. There is something in the oven.
vex>alaric: You already knew that.
I did. You wanted to say it.
You are not going to argue.
No. You are right, and it does not need two of us.
How long have you been standing there.
Long enough to hear the good part.
alaric>vex: You are working late again.
I am working correctly. The hour is incidental.
That will still be there tomorrow.
So will I. That is not the argument you think it is.
You were right earlier.
I know. Say it anyway.

julian+vex: I am aware of the jurisdiction. I want the coffee.
alaric+julian: Sit down, I will bring it over.
I can carry a plate, Julian.
alaric+vex: He is not here and nothing is where it should be.
Leave it as you found it and he will never know.

julian+vex: Sit down, it is going cold.
It is not going cold. You have said that of three courses and none of them were.
alaric+julian: There is a chair at the end with more room in it.
I know. You put it there.
alaric+vex: You have taken the seat facing the door.

julian+vex: I am not going to ask what you are working on.
Good. I was not going to tell you.
alaric+julian: You have been in here a long while.
Thinking is not idling. It only looks the same from a doorway.
alaric+vex: You read slower than you need to.
I read at the speed the thing deserves.

julian+vex: Something you would put down after four pages.
alaric+julian: Yes. Ask me again when I have finished it.
alaric+vex: You have had that open at the same page for an hour.

julian+vex: Careful where you stand, there is something under there.
There is something under everything out here. It is a garden.
alaric+julian: Two things. Neither of them the one you want.
alaric+vex: You planted these in the wrong order.
I planted them in the order they went into the ground.

alaric+julian: There is room on that side for one more.
alaric+vex: Neither of us is going to say anything, are we.

julian>vex: Your room is louder than mine and there is nobody in it.
That is the nicest thing you have ever said about it.
julian>alaric: You could fit another shelf on that wall.
I could fit another room on that wall. I choose not to.
vex>julian: There is nothing in here.
There is everything I use in here. You are confusing the two.
vex>alaric: You keep it bare.
I keep it accurate.
alaric>julian: It is very quiet in here.
Yes.
alaric>vex: You have one chair.
I have one back.

any: julian
All three of us in one room. This never happens.
vex
It happens roughly once a fortnight. You say that every time.
alaric
He likes saying it.
vex
We are all standing. Nobody has sat down.
julian
I will get chairs.
alaric
Do not get chairs.
alaric
It is quiet.
julian
It was quiet. You have all just started talking about it being quiet.
vex
He is right. We ruined it in under four seconds.
julian
Right, while I have both of you.
vex
No.
alaric
Let him finish.
kitchen: Out, both of you. There is a thing in the oven and neither of you respects it.
I have respected everything in that oven. I simply do not care about it.
I will take the bins down.
There is not enough room in here for three.
There is exactly enough room for three. None of it is where you are standing.
dining: Sit, all of you. It goes cold and then it is somehow my fault.
It has never once been your fault and you have never once believed that.
Somebody say something before he starts serving.
Too late. I have started serving.
living: This is nice. Nobody is doing anything.
I am doing something. You cannot see it, which is the point.
Three of us and one couch.
Two of us and one couch. I am fine on the floor.
study: It holds one person comfortably. It is holding three uncomfortably, which is a different measurement.
garden: The one you are standing on.

julian>vex: You are up before the light again.
The light is late. I am on time.
Coffee?
Yes. Do not make a thing of it.
vex>julian: You have been humming since six.
Have I. Sorry. No I am not.
There is flour on the door handle.
There is flour on most things. It is a working kitchen.
julian>alaric: You were up before me. That is rare.
It is not. You are simply not usually awake to notice.
Sit down, I will bring it over.
I have been sitting since four. I am going to stand a while.
alaric>julian: Eat something before you start.
I eat all day. At this point it is practically a profession.
The morning is long. Do not spend all of it before nine.
Noted. Ignored, but noted.
vex>alaric: You have already been out.
The water was flat. Worth the hour.
You are quieter than usual this early.
I have not decided anything yet. It shows.
alaric>vex: You did not sleep.
I slept enough. The hour is mine either way.
Morning.
It is. You do not have to say it every day.
trio: All three of you awake before eight. Something is wrong.
He means he has to make more coffee.

julian>vex: This is the dead part of the day.
It is the useful part. You are simply bored.
Second lunch?
That is not a meal. Bring it anyway.
vex>julian: You have been to the shop twice.
Three times. The third does not count, I forgot the eggs.
You have not sat down since noon.
There is a chair. We are acquainted.
julian>alaric: What are you building.
Nothing yet. I am still looking at it.
Come and eat, it is going cold.
Then it will be cold. I will still eat it.
alaric>julian: You have not stopped since the morning.
I will stop when the oven does.
Ten minutes. Sit.
In a minute. There is something proving.
vex>alaric: You have been staring at that for an hour.
Yes. It is not finished being looked at.
That is the third time you have measured it.
It is. It will be the last.
alaric>vex: Put it down for ten minutes.
I will put it down when it stops being interesting.
You have read that page twice.
I have read it four times. It is dense.
trio: The afternoon is the only honest part of the day.
That is a very long way of saying you had a nap.

julian>vex: Still up?
Obviously. So are you.
Kitchen is open if you want anything.
The kitchen is always open. That is not an offer, it is a condition.
vex>julian: The kitchen light has been on an hour and you are not in it.
I know. I like knowing it is there.
You are tidying at midnight.
It is calming. Do not analyse it.
julian>alaric: You have been quiet all evening.
Yes. It has been a good evening.
One more and then I am done.
You said that an hour ago. Carry on.
alaric>julian: Leave the washing up.
I will not, and you know I will not.
It is late.
It is. I am nearly at the good bit.
vex>alaric: You are still awake.
I am. It is the best hour for it.
Nobody has moved in twenty minutes.
No. Leave it that way.
alaric>vex: The house is quiet.
It is. Do not fill it.
You will be up at five regardless.
I will. That is my business.
trio: I will put the kettle on, then.

julian>vex: The window is open.
I noticed. I have said nothing about it for three days.
vex>julian: You have started leaving the back door open.
It is spring. The kitchen wants the air.
julian>alaric: Anything going in the ground this week?
Something. I will know when I am up there.
alaric>julian: The light is back.
It is. I have been getting up earlier and calling it discipline.
vex>alaric: Everything is starting at once out there.
Yes. It always does. It is still worth watching.
alaric>vex: You have been outside more this month.
The light is longer. I am not making a statement about it.
trio: Everything smells like rain and cut grass.
That is two things and one of them is next door's.

julian>vex: Too hot for the oven.
And yet.
vex>julian: It is thirty degrees and you have made bread.
I have made bread. I stand by it.
julian>alaric: You were in the water again.
Twice. It is the only sensible room in the building.
alaric>julian: Eat something cold.
That is the plan. It has been the plan since Tuesday.
vex>alaric: The evenings do not end.
No. Use them.
alaric>vex: You have been out past midnight all week.
Nothing closes. It would be rude not to.
trio: Long light and nobody has eaten.
Those are related and only one of you is going to fix it.

julian>vex: Soup weather.
You have been saying that since August.
vex>julian: Something in this flat smells of cinnamon and I want it noted that I have not complained.
Noted. There is a bowl on the side.
julian>alaric: You are bringing things in.
I am. There is not much time left for the ones outside.
alaric>julian: The dark comes early now.
Then we will eat early. I do not mind it.
vex>alaric: Everything out there is letting go of what it cannot carry.
Yes. I am not going to say the rest of that either.
alaric>vex: You like this one.
I like the part where it gets quiet. That is not the same thing.
trio: The light goes at four now.
Which is why the oven is on at three.

julian>vex: It is warm in here.
It is. That is the entire argument for a kitchen.
vex>julian: You have had the oven on all day.
I have. It is structural.
julian>alaric: Cold out?
Very. It clarifies things.
alaric>julian: Nobody is going anywhere today.
Good. I will cook something that takes six hours.
vex>alaric: Sound carries in this air.
It does. You can hear the quay from the roof.
alaric>vex: You have been on the roof in this.
Briefly. It is clearer up there.
trio: Everyone is in one room and nobody planned it.
That is the whole explanation and he was hoping for a better one.

julian>vex: Monday.
It is a day. It has no opinion about you.
julian>alaric: Monday.
Yes. Start with one thing.
vex>alaric: Everyone is slower today.
They are allowed to be.
trio: It is Monday. It is not a fresh start, it is a Monday.

julian>vex: It is Friday.
It is. You have mentioned it four times.
julian>alaric: Friday. Anything planned?
Nothing. That is the plan.
vex>alaric: The week is over and you have not slowed down.
The week ending is not an instruction.
trio: Friday. I am making something ridiculous.
I will be here. That is not enthusiasm, it is logistics.

julian>vex: Nobody has to be anywhere.
You say that and then you are up at six.
julian>alaric: No hurry today.
There never was. You simply believe it more on a Saturday.
vex>alaric: The building is quiet.
The whole street is. It is the best two days of the week for it.
trio: I love it when he says things like that.
He says one thing like that a month and you quote it for weeks.

julian>vex: New year.
The number changed. The kitchen did not.
julian>alaric: Feels like a start.
It is a day with a new number on it. Start anyway.
vex>alaric: People make declarations at this time of year.
They do. Some of them keep them.
trio: He was going to say he has none. Let him say it.

julian>vex: Last few days of it.
Yes. I am not going to summarise them.
julian>alaric: Odd week, this one.
It is. Nothing is due and nobody knows what day it is.
vex>alaric: Nothing is running this week.
No. It is the only week that is honest about it.
trio: The week between is the strangest one there is.
It is the only one with nothing owed in it.
So obviously I am cooking for six.

julian>vex: Shortest day.
And then it turns. That is the only good thing about December.
julian>alaric: Dark by four.
Yes. It comes back from here.
vex>alaric: It stops getting worse today.
It does. That is worth marking.

julian>vex: Longest day.
Enjoy it. It is downhill from here and I will not be told otherwise.
julian>alaric: It is barely dark.
No. Stay up.
vex>alaric: It does not get properly dark tonight.
No. Good night for the roof.
trio: He has been up since four using it. Look at him.
